name: Quantified TRI Form R on-site releases per capita
source: EPA 2024 TRI Basic California full reporting file; Census Population Estimates Program Vintage 2025 July 2024 population; official LAFCO/Census boundary crosschecks
notes: Tier 1 exhausted via City General Plan/Environmental Safety Element and city/county TRI-specific searches; city material is policy-oriented (adopted 2009), county CUPA materials concern hazardous-material storage/emergency response rather than annual TRI releases, and the county CUPA page returned 403. Tier 2 accepted EPA complete 2024 California TRI Basic file (forms processed as of November 5, 2025), including federal/tribal facilities, and Census Population Estimates Program Vintage 2025 POPESTIMATE2024 for July 1, 2024. On-site releases are field 65, comprising air, surface water, underground injection and land disposal; off-site releases/transfers, treatment, recycling, energy recovery and total waste managed are excluded. All selected rows are Pounds, not kg; no dioxin grams occur in the selected county data. TRI covers certain industries and federal facilities meeting employee/chemical thresholds; this is reported chemical mass, not all pollution, toxicity-weighted risk or exposure. Reproducible raw files, hashes, row extracts and standard-library Python scripts are under calculations/chemical-pollution/. Primary exhibit is a visually reviewed researcher-generated faithful extract; the official EPA source and Census bytes are separately archived. All-county result: eight forms at six facilities; county-name MONTEREY selection exactly matches the statewide coordinates inside the complete county polygon, covering incorporated and unincorporated areas. Numerator 24,485.44 lb sums seven quantified Form R rows only. DOLE FRESH VEGETABLES INC chlorine uses Form A; its Basic-file zero is an unquantified placeholder, not a measured zero. Any release associated with that Form A is omitted from the quantified sum. Form A certifies total annual reportable amount at most 500 lb, so the corresponding unquantified on-site contribution could be 0–500 lb; an upper bound would yield (24,485.44+500)/433,447 = 0.05764358733593726 lb/resident/year, not an observed estimate. Population 433,447 is July 1, 2024 Census Vintage 2025 county 06053, not ACS multiyear population.
